label: Orgs with a sourced fact
means: Share of data/orgs files whose fact cites a source with an https URL, a quote and a read date.
goal_source: Space Peak's own goal, from launch plan step 46 (Colorado-Startups/space-peak#125), which Paul approved on 2026-11-16. CONTRIBUTING.md, Sources and read dates, sets what a source holds: an https URL, a read date and a quote of 15 words or fewer. Near is 90%, one org in ten.
source: state now: data/orgs/*.yaml whose fact cites a source with an https URL, a quote and a read date, and that site/src/lib/orgs/check.ts checkOrgs gives no fact.source issue (a source read over 365 days ago, or a fact URL another org uses)

label: Figures with a status chip
means: Share of figures on the built pages whose chip shows the claim's status in the claims register.
goal_source: Space Peak's own goal, from launch plan step 46 (Colorado-Startups/space-peak#125), which Paul approved on 2026-11-16. The claims register lists every checkable claim with a status (02_substance/claims_register.md). 01_doctrine/voice.md says a summit's claims carry their register status. Near is 90%, one figure in ten.
source: state now: elements with data-claim or class figure on the site/dist pages that hold a .figure-chip whose word is the claim's status in site/dist/data/claims.json; not measured while the built pages show no figure

label: Orgs of the smallest kind
means: Organisations of the kind with fewest: command bases, institutions or companies.
goal_source: A goal, not a fact: Space Peak's own target of 10 organisations of each kind, from launch plan step 46 (Colorado-Startups/space-peak#125), which Paul approved on 2026-11-16. Near is 5, half the goal.
source: state now: data/orgs/*.yaml counted by each kind in site/src/lib/orgs/kinds.ts; the value is the smallest count, and a kind with no org counts 0

label: Open data files that validate
means: Share of /data/ files whose bytes match index.json's sha256 and whose body matches its JSON Schema.
goal_source: Space Peak's own goal, from launch plan step 46 (Colorado-Startups/space-peak#125), which Paul approved on 2026-11-16. Step 39 publishes each /data/ file with a JSON Schema and a sha256 in /data/index.json, so a reader or an agent can check every file. Near is 90%, one file in ten.
source: state now: site/dist/data/index.json and every file it lists, each against its sha256 there and its JSON Schema under site/dist/data/schemas/ (zod fromJSONSchema), orgs.csv row by row; a schema file must load as a JSON Schema
